title: Restore the full chart-268 operator by rebinding owner 17
body:
## Result

Move owner 17’s input from chart 19 to chart 0. Use the new grade-one 0→19 receipt immediately before native packet 785, keep original 1583, and retarget 3409 from chart 421 to chart 0. The retargeted packet plus local x17 recovers every one of the 63 old 3410 readers. The literal word agrees with all 680 native output rows and their 680 adjoint rows, including owners 221, 411, and 679. The protected packet 3553 is unchanged. A rank-six information cut forces an extra arrival if the original five chart-19 outgoing values and owner 671 stay exact.

## Price and remaining premises

The paired caller rejects the rebind at main port 17: the new zero-dimensional head cannot complement its seven-dimensional body. The actual native paid delta is −H(5)+H(6). Even granting an optimistic, hypothetical 36-fold grade-7→8 productive credit, the BIT margin is about −0.07064423157095918 at κ = 0.00388. That is an arithmetic control, with the pinned rational margin +0.13897452233425271. The changed outer geometry, its full signed price, owned erasure and a finite application remain open. No new κ bound is claimed.

## Replay

Archive SHA-256 `41d208aa309f366ccf64eedd406651309be38562941cee2aa8314dcbdc961f79`. A fresh extraction passed `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, `python3 -I -B build.py`, `python3 -I -B no_extra_gate.py` and the repeated manifest. Word SHA-256 `02c0c7c0c0be4875a9e2265ba4c37559648035304f3fe95cb6b9a8932439640b`.

## Prior and parallel work

The positive operator repairs the precise missing source direction from #8012, head `d6efaa1893dc033a05fcfa06e6bd25393ba2df1c`. #7863 `b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781` and #7973 `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca` supply the comparable outer result. A complementary search keeps the original productive endpoints fixed.
